profile.name: NI数字输出设备
profile.description: 这是一类美国国家仪器的数字输出数据采集设备，用于输出开关量或TTL电平信号，在实验中常用于触发其他仪器、控制继电器或快门、切换外部电路状态，以及实现时序同步控制。
profile.description_en: This is a National Instruments digital output data acquisition device used to generate digital or TTL-level signals. In laboratory setups, it is commonly used to trigger other instruments, control relays or shutters, switch external circuit states, and provide timing synchronization.
